content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, traditional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable, leaving digital creators without a reliable way to accept payments for their ebooks. This guide addresses how to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-explained-digital-creators-stripe-7|Bitcoin Payments]] for ebook sales, leveraging sovereign infrastructure that eliminates reliance on conventional payment systems. With NOWPayments, you can process transactions seamlessly, retaining more revenue compared to platforms that impose high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% cut. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-8|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-pages-free-step-step-11|deploying]] your own digital commerce stack, you gain full control over your sales process, ensuring that you can operate independently and efficiently.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The failure of payment platforms to serve regions like Africa and South America creates a significant barrier for digital creators. With COREMERCH's sovereign digital commerce stacks, you establish a robust infrastructure that eliminates dependency on platforms that charge excessive fees and impose restrictions. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, ensuring that you keep more of your earnings. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a substantial 10% cut on sales, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This difference translates to substantial savings; for instance, on 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you retain an additional $921. This infrastructure empowers you to operate freely and sustainably.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you get started, gather the essential tools for your digital commerce stack. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your site and a Google account for managing your backend with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Additionally, ensure you have a NOWPayments account set up to process Bitcoin transactions. Familiarize yourself with the deployment process of your chosen stack, whether it’s the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. You should also prepare your products, ensuring they are ready for upload with proper descriptions and visuals. Having everything in place will streamline your deployment process and set you up for success.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To effectively accept Bitcoin for your ebook sales, establish a seamless payment and delivery pipeline. Start by integrating NOWPayments into your commerce stack to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Follow the integration guide provided in the Sovereign Blueprint to connect your NOWPayments account. Next, set up automated delivery for your products using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that once a transaction is confirmed, your customers receive their ebooks instantly without manual intervention. Test the entire flow with dummy transactions to confirm that payments and product delivery function flawlessly before going live.
Retain more revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery systems are set up, it's time to go live. Publish your site to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, depending on your chosen stack. Announce your ebook launch through social media channels, leveraging your existing audience. When you receive your first order, monitor the transaction through the NOWPayments dashboard to ensure everything works as intended. This initial transaction will validate your setup and give you confidence in your new system. If issues arise, troubleshoot them promptly to ensure a smooth experience for your future customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial sales, focus on scaling your operations. Consider expanding your product offerings beyond ebooks to include courses, templates, or software, utilizing the Complete Builder Kit for additional blueprints and templates. This comprehensive kit provides you with everything you need to enhance your digital store’s functionality, worth $348 separately but available for only $197. Evaluate customer feedback and optimize your offerings accordingly. Engage in marketing strategies like email campaigns and partnerships to drive traffic to your site. Monitor your sales metrics to identify opportunities for growth and make data-driven decisions moving forward.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Gain full control over your sales process with no outside dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create accounts on GitHub and Google. Set up a NOWPayments account for handling cryptocurrency. Gather your product materials and descriptions. Deploy your chosen stack on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Set up automated delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Test your setup with dummy transactions before going live. Launch your site and promote your ebooks through social media.
